info.name: Digital Employee API v2
info.description:
Complete & updated Postman collection for the Digital Employee ASP.NET Core API.

Base URL: http://localhost:5157

--- RECOMMENDED TEST FLOW ---
**A — Bootstrap admin / owner, then create business (no deadlock)**
1. Register Admin or Owner → POST /api/Auth/register-admin | register-owner — body: **fullName, email, password** only (RegisterBootstrapDTO)
2. Login → POST /api/Auth/login (saves token)
3. Create Business → POST /api/Business (Bearer token; **OwnerOrAdmin**)
4. Register Agent → POST /api/Auth/register — **businessId** + user fields (RegisterDTO)
5. Menu → Customer → Order as needed

**B — Public full onboarding**
1. Onboard Business → POST /api/Business/onboard (saves `businessId`)
2. Register Owner (optional) with `businessId` from step 1, or use flow A
3. Login → continue

--- PAYLOAD NOTES ---
- **RegisterBootstrapDTO** (`register-admin`, `register-owner`): `fullName`, `email`, `password` only.
- **RegisterDTO** (`POST /api/Auth/register` agent): includes required `businessId`.
- **Update order status**: body must include `orderId` and `status` (enum names: Pending, PendingConfirmation, Paid, DelayedRisk, Delivered, Cancelled).
- **Onboard**: uses `BusinessOnboardingDTO` (see Onboard request).

--- ROLES ---
- Admin:  Full system access
- Owner:  Manage their own business
- Agent:  Handle tickets, chat, orders (default role for /register)
- User:   Reserved (not used in normal registration flow)

--- AUTH ---
Protected endpoints use Bearer token from {{token}}. Public endpoints use noauth.

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. register-admin and register-owner are public (no token needed); businessId is optional for those. POST /api/Auth/register (agent) requires a valid businessId.

request.description:
Creates a new user with Admin role. No token required.

Body is **RegisterBootstrapDTO** — only `fullName`, `email`, `password` (no `businessId`). After login, call **POST /api/Business** to create a restaurant.

Creates a new user with Owner role. No token required.

**RegisterBootstrapDTO** — only `fullName`, `email`, `password`. To attach to an existing business from onboard, use your app flow or create business after login.

One-step signup: creates a Business AND an Owner account atomically. No BusinessId needed — it is generated server-side and returned in the response. The test script auto-saves token, userId and businessId as collection variables.

Use this as the primary public registration endpoint.
Creates a new user with Agent role. **businessId** is required and must exist. Run after creating/onboarding a business.

Token, userId, and businessId are auto-saved to collection variables.

**Example response (200)**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbGciOi...",
  "expiration": "2026-04-15T12:00:00Z",
  "userId": "guid",
  "email": "admin@app.com",
  "fullName": "Super Admin",
  "role": "Admin",
  "businessId": "guid-or-null"
}
```

request.description:
Full **BusinessOnboardingDTO** example: business + agent settings + optional menu + subscription + card (prototype).

- `planName` must be **Monthly** or **Yearly** (case-insensitive).
- `phone` must match API validation (E.164-style, e.g. +201012345678).
- `cardExpiryYear` must be current year or later.
- Empty `knowledgeBaseItems` is OK; if you add items, each needs `question` and `answer`.

On success, **businessId** is saved from `id` in the JSON response.

request.description:
**OrderCreateDTO** — `businessId`, `customerId`, and `items` (each item: `menuItemId`, `quantity`).

Use **Create Customer** and **Create Menu Item** first so variables are set, or replace GUIDs with real IDs.

**UpdateOrderStatusDTO** — both `orderId` (required by validation) and `status` must be present. URL uses the same order id as `{{orderId}}`.

**status** must match `OrderStatus` enum names exactly (case-sensitive):
- Pending
- PendingConfirmation
- Paid
- DelayedRisk
- Delivered
- Cancelled

**Example payloads**
```json
{ "orderId": "{{orderId}}", "status": "Pending" }
{ "orderId": "{{orderId}}", "status": "Delivered" }
{ "orderId": "{{orderId}}", "status": "Cancelled" }
```

request.description:
**SettingUpdateDTO** — all fields optional; send only what you want to change.

Supported keys include: `autoAssignTickets`, `enableNotifications`, `language`, `timeZone`, `chatbotEnabled`, `chatbotWelcomeMessage`, `chatbotPersonality`, voice fields (`agentVoice`, `agentVoiceProvider`, …), `customSystemPrompt`, `customGreetingTemplate`, `emailNotifications`, `smsNotifications`, `pushNotifications`.
**ChatbotRequestDTO** — `question` (required). `conversationId` is optional for multi-turn context; omit or set to null for a new thread.
